summary: Verified iteration-7 bug fix (cert count 37) and re-uploaded videos. Cert count fix WORKS end-to-end. Video playback for the 4 re-uploaded background videos (skills, certifications, contact, activity) is BROKEN in the browser due to incompatible container/codec of the uploaded source files (not a code bug).

minor.issue: Response missing 'Accept-Ranges: bytes' and returns HTTP 200 (not 206) for Range requests. FastAPI StaticFiles + Cloudflare edge do not honor byte-range on these responses; also 'Cache-Control: no-store' disables edge caching. This forces the browser to download the entire file (up to 57 MB) before playback and prevents seek. Recommend serving videos with a Range-aware handler (e.g., custom StreamingResponse honoring Range) or moving them to a CDN/object store.

ui_bugs.issue: The 4 re-uploaded videos fail to play. HTMLMediaElement reports: 'PipelineStatus::DEMUXER_ERROR_NO_SUPPORTED_STREAMS: FFmpegDemuxer: no supported streams'. readyState stays 0, currentTime stays 0, paused=true after 20+ seconds. The <video> tag is correctly wired (autoPlay/loop/muted/playsInline, src matches /api/uploads/videos/{slug}.mp4, HTTP 200 served) — the failure is inside the media decode pipeline.

action_items: Re-encode the 4 uploaded videos to browser-compatible MP4 (H.264 baseline/main + AAC, container ftyp='mp42'/'isom'). Root cause: 3 of 4 files are QuickTime containers (ftyp='qt  ') renamed to .mp4 which Chromium/Firefox refuse to demux; skills.mp4 has ftyp='isom/avc1' but the internal codec/profile still fails DEMUXER on Chromium. See RCA section.
Add server-side validation on video upload endpoint to (a) inspect ftyp box and reject non-'mp42/isom/iso2' containers, or (b) transcode with ffmpeg to H.264+AAC MP4 on ingest.
Add Range-request support to /api/uploads/videos/* (custom StreamingResponse) so large videos begin playback progressively instead of downloading in full.
Optional: remove 'Cache-Control: no-store' from static video responses to allow CDN caching.
critical_code_review_comments: VideoBackground.jsx has no onError handler — silent failures for users. Add an onError that logs and/or falls back to poster image only.
Consider adding <source type='video/mp4; codecs=avc1.42E01E,mp4a.40.2'> so the browser can early-reject incompatible files and pick alternates.
Video upload endpoint (admin CMS) does not appear to validate MIME/codec — allowed a .mov-inside-mp4 to be persisted.

success_rate.frontend: 60% (cert-count fix passes; 4 video backgrounds fail to play)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Cert count fix is confirmed: /api/certifications returns 37; home hero-stat-certifications shows '37'; certifications page header shows '// 37 credentials verified'. Video files at /app/backend/uploads/videos/{skills,certifications,contact,activity}.mp4 need to be re-encoded before video playback tests can pass. Working reference: home.mp4/summary.mp4/education.mp4/experience.mp4 have ftyp='mp42/isom/avc1' and play fine.

rca of the issue.symptom: Background video is invisible on /skills, /certifications, /contact, /activity even though the <video> element is present with correct attributes and the file returns HTTP 200.
rca of the issue.evidence: In-browser HTMLMediaElement.error.message = 'PipelineStatus::DEMUXER_ERROR_NO_SUPPORTED_STREAMS: FFmpegDemuxer: no supported streams'. video.readyState=0, video.networkState=3 (NETWORK_NO_SOURCE) after 20s.
rca of the issue.root_cause: The re-uploaded files are not standards-compliant MP4/H.264. Inspection of the ftyp box: certifications.mp4/contact.mp4/activity.mp4 = 'qt  ' (Apple QuickTime .mov container renamed to .mp4). skills.mp4 = 'isom/iso2/avc1/mp41' — container is fine but Chromium still fails to demux, suggesting the codec profile inside (likely HEVC/ProRes or non-standard AVC profile) is unsupported. Compare with the previously-working home.mp4 which shows ftyp='mp42/isom/avc1'.
rca of the issue.reproduction: 1) curl -sI https://.../api/uploads/videos/contact.mp4  -> 200 OK, 12 MB.  2) Open /contact in Chrome, check document.querySelector('video').error -> DEMUXER_ERROR_NO_SUPPORTED_STREAMS.  3) hexdump -C /app/backend/uploads/videos/contact.mp4 | head -1 -> shows 'ftypqt  ' (QuickTime).
rca of the issue.mitigation: Re-encode the four files on ingest: ffmpeg -i input -c:v libx264 -profile:v main -pix_fmt yuv420p -movflags +faststart -c:a aac -b:a 128k output.mp4. Also add a validation step on the admin upload endpoint that rejects non-mp42/isom ftyp or auto-transcodes.
